ayahs.1: The Striking Calamity—the Day that shatters every routine and every illusion of control.
ayahs.3: And what will make you grasp what the Striking Calamity is?
ayahs.4: It is the Day humanity will scatter like moths thrown into light—panicked, directionless, fragile.
ayahs.5: And mountains will become like carded wool—massive structures reduced to weightless dust.
ayahs.6: Then as for those whose scales of deeds are heavy with iman and righteous action—
ayahs.7: they will dwell in a pleasing life in the Akhirah.
ayahs.8: And as for those whose scales are light—
ayahs.9: their refuge will be Hawiyah, an abyss of loss.
ayahs.10: And what will explain to you what that is?
